messages:
incident-bot: PAGER: cascade-pager - multiple services reporting elevated 5xx rates and token latency > 2s. Impact: hosted API (us-east-1). Triggered at 2026-03-14T02:11:30Z.

marta: I'm on it. joining bridge.

sam: seeing spike on edge-gateway -> 503s into model-proxy. beginning rapid triage.

priya: adding logs. looks related to recent routing-policy change (priority fallback) + kv-cache invalidations.

esteban: can we flip fallback to model-variant-b to reduce load? I have the toggle.

marta: yes flip it. use this command: `redwoodctl route set-priority --route /v1/generate --primary model-a --fallback model-b`

esteban: flipped fallback, warming model-b. requests still spiky but 503s dropping. :thumbsup:

elena: noticed a burst of cache-invalidations from the edge after an S3 5xx during artifact re-fetch. KV eviction flooded the runtime.

sam: logs snippet:
```
2026-03-14T02:11:28Z ERROR kv-client: eviction flood detected, pending writes queued=12345
2026-03-14T02:11:29Z WARN runtime: backend busy, enqueuing request id=... latency=1.9s
2026-03-14T02:11:30Z ERROR proxy: upstream 503 model-proxy shard=3
```

marta: mitigation summary: 1) flipped fallback to model-b 2) paused cache invalidation propagation 3) throttled edge retries. customer-facing latency back within SLO now.

incident-bot: INCIDENT STATUS: mitigated -> monitoring. severity: SEV2.

priya: good job. next steps: post-incident review, action items, runbook updates. who can own scheduling the postmortem?

marta: I'll own scheduling and notes. suggest block Wed 10am PT for the 60m triage/postmortem.

esteban: want a quick pre-read: root cause looks like combined effect of (a) routing-policy rollout that prioritized local region model-a, (b) a transient S3 error causing synchronous artifact re-fetch, (c) aggressive KV cache invalidation logic that didn't backoff.

sam: action item list draft: - A1: Add deploy-time verification for routing-policy rollouts (owner: sam, due: 2026-03-21) - A2: Add backoff and circuit-breaker to KV invalidation path (owner: esteban, due: 2026-03-28) - A3: Add synthetic test that simulates S3 artifact error to validate warmup + cache stability (owner: priya, due: 2026-03-25) - A4: Update runbook: clear steps for flipping model fallbacks and when to throttle edge retries (owner: marta, due: 2026-03-18)

elena: suggest A5: instrument prefix of requests to trace which deploy introduced the routing-policy change (owner: elena, due: 2026-03-20).

marta: I'll create the postmortem doc and link it in this thread. rough outline: timeline, root cause, blast radius, mitigations, action items.

priya: for the runbook edits, propose adding a new section "cascade-pager playbook" with: detection checks, immediate mitigations (fallback flip, pause kv sync, throttle edge), when to declare customer-impact, comms template, owner rotation notes.

sam: can we add a canary step to the routing rollout: 5% traffic baseline + synthetic verification for 10 minutes before wider rollout? put into Dedicated/Docker manifest.

marta: agreed. will include canary requirement in deploy checklist. also add a pre-commit lint for routing-policy JSON to avoid bad prioritization configs.

triage-bot: REMINDER: please add action owners to the action-tracker (use /action add) and set due dates.

marta: adding actions now. /action add "Add deploy-time verification for routing rollouts" sam 2026-03-21
/action add "Circuit-breaker for KV invalidation" esteban 2026-03-28
/action add "Synthetic S3 artifact error test" priya 2026-03-25
/action add "Runbook: cascade-pager playbook" marta 2026-03-18
/action add "Traceability for routing deploys" elena 2026-03-20

esteban: for the runbook change, recommend including a decision tree: if 5xx rate > X and latency > Y -> flip fallback; if cache eviction > Z -> pause invalidations and scale KV writers.

priya: also add comms template for customer-facing updates: short description, impact, mitigations, ETA for full root-cause, link to postmortem. keep it < 3 bullets.

marta: putting tentative postmortem calendar invite now. Wed 2026-03-18 10:00 PT -> link: <https://calendar.redwood.com/meet/pm-2003017890>.

sam: pinging infra to reserve conf room for a pair debugging session next week (will need GPU cluster access).

elena: quick note: for Private deployments, we should ensure fallback toggles are available in the private console and documented — add to runbook A4 as a subtask.

marta: noted. adding subtask: "Document fallback toggle for Private/VPC" owner: marta due: 2026-03-18.

incident-bot: ACTIONS UPDATED. Current open actions: 5.

priya: last thing — retrospective improvement: shorten notification windows for incident-bot when multiple sources escalate same incident, so oncall knows it's a cascade, not several separate incidents. file follow-up: onboarding for incident-bot config (owner: priya, due: 2026-03-22).

marta: thanks team. I'll post the postmortem doc and link the actions after the meeting. if anyone wants to pull any of the action owners earlier, DM me. closing thread for live ops — will re-open after postmortem doc created. :white_check_mark:
